citations.claim: total energy at first violating step has drifted far from E0 -483.4 to -620.4
body 0 speed inflated to ~12.35 during deep close encounter just before violation
initial speed was only ~1.4, showing violent gravitational acceleration into pericenter

counterfactual.change: halved outer dt from 0.0176755 to 0.008 with all else identical; finer resolution removes the energy drift

explanation: Two ~17-18 mass bodies with G~4.73 fall toward each other to separation ~0.35-0.39 (steps 22-23), comparable to softening 0.3. Potential deepens to ~-3000 and kinetic rises to ~2500, but substeps only increase to 13-16 per outer step. Fixed-dt leapfrog with this substepping under-resolves the sharp pericenter, producing systematic energy error that accumulates to 137 (allowed 117) by step 24. Halving dt removes the violation, confirming timestep resolution as cause.
vision_note: Two bodies near the top-center undergo an extremely close encounter and appear nearly overlapping from step 21 through 24. Their short trails show rapid infall toward each other with separation shrinking to roughly contact by steps 23-24.
